betterquesting:10.desc:8:
A mirror lets another machine share the source matrix's ordered input without copying materials.

Build the destination to match the source layout, replacing only one corresponding compartment with a mirror. After source processing has finished and its buffers are empty, left-click a source compartment with a GT Data Stick, then right-click the corresponding mirror to bind it.

Keep both groups loaded in the same dimension. Do not connect the destination to ME.
